count_definitions.package_administration_questions: Entries assigned the advisory PACKAGE_ADMINISTRATION label.

count_definitions.current_phase_blockers: Calculator validation blocking question IDs FIN-001, FIN-002, FIN-003.

count_definitions.questions_presented_in_calculator_sessio: Only prompts with persisted direct HUMAN_DECLARATION transitions; no UI event log proves other cards were actually viewed.
count_definitions.questions_still_unresolved: Unresolved according to the unanswered exporter (needs_answer answer-kind only), not overall readiness.
